quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC of 21.25% reflects high capital efficiency of flagship asset Action (>50% new store ROIC) and disciplined holdco capital allocation. Forward 5-10Y compound growth of 10.0% is underpinned by Action's European store rollout (+6.5%), like-for-like volume growth (+3.0%), and modest operational leverage (+0.5%), offset by private equity realizations (-0.5%). Holdco balance sheet is pristine with net debt/earnings at 0.12x and interest coverage of 76.6x.
